tools.name: opentoclose_list_agents
tools.description: List agents with name/email search and documented sorting. One offset/limit page. GET /v1/agents/.

tools.name: opentoclose_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts with name/email search and documented sorting. One offset/limit page. GET /v1/contacts.

tools.name: opentoclose_list_contact_roles
tools.description: List contact roles. GET /v1/contactRoles/.

tools.name: opentoclose_list_file_roles
tools.description: List file roles. GET /v1/fileRoles/.

tools.name: opentoclose_list_property_fields
tools.description: List property fields grouped into sections. GET /v1/propertyFields.

tools.name: opentoclose_list_property_field_groups
tools.description: List property field groups. GET /v1/propertyFieldGroups.

tools.name: opentoclose_list_property_field_sections
tools.description: List property field sections. GET /v1/propertyFieldSections.

tools.name: opentoclose_list_property_templates
tools.description: List property templates. GET /v1/propertyTemplates/.

tools.name: opentoclose_list_teams
tools.description: List teams and their members. GET /v1/teams/.

tools.name: opentoclose_list_time_zones
tools.description: List time zones. GET /v1/timeZones/.

tools.name: opentoclose_list_tags
tools.description: List tags. GET /v1/tags.

tools.name: opentoclose_list_properties
tools.description: List properties with team/agent summaries through the current v1.1 endpoint. Maximum 50 per call. This does not return a property's full field values. GET /v1.1/properties.

tools.name: opentoclose_list_property_contacts
tools.description: List contacts associated with a property, optionally filtered by name/email. GET /v1/properties/{property_id}/contacts.

tools.name: opentoclose_list_property_documents
tools.description: Read a property's document folders and document metadata/links. Does not download files. GET /v1/properties/{property_id}/documents.

tools.name: opentoclose_list_property_notes
tools.description: List notes associated with a property. One offset/limit page. GET /v1/properties/{property_id}/notes.

tools.name: opentoclose_get_property_note
tools.description: Read one note associated with a property. GET /v1/properties/{property_id}/notes/{record_id}.

tools.name: opentoclose_list_property_tasks
tools.description: List tasks associated with a property. GET /v1/properties/{property_id}/tasks.

tools.name: opentoclose_get_property_task
tools.description: Read one task associated with a property. GET /v1/properties/{property_id}/tasks/{record_id}.

tools.name: opentoclose_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact. Search existing contacts first to avoid duplicates, then confirm the requested details. Creates a contact record without associating it with a property. Returns a created record ID. POST /v1/contacts.

tools.name: opentoclose_add_property_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a property. Confirm the property and note content/visibility with the user first. Adds another note on each call; inspect current notes before retrying. Optional visibility fields are omitted unless supplied; the vendor documents null defaults. POST /v1/properties/{property_id}/

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: opentoclose_list_agents, opentoclose_list_contacts, opentoclose_list_property_contacts, opentoclose_create_contact · Private data: opentoclose_list_contacts, opentoclose_list_contact_roles, opentoclose_list_file_roles, opentoclose_list_property_contacts, opentoclose_list_property_documents, opentoclose_create_contact, opentoclose_add_property_note · Public sink: opentoclose_list_agents, opentoclose_list_contacts, opentoclose_list_property_contacts, opentoclose_create_contact, opentoclose_add_property_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: opentoclose_list_agents, opentoclose_list_contacts, opentoclose_list_property_contacts, opentoclose_create_contact · Private data: opentoclose_list_contacts, opentoclose_list_contact_roles, opentoclose_list_file_roles, opentoclose_list_property_contacts, opentoclose_list_property_documents, opentoclose_create_contact, opentoclose_add_property_note · Public sink: opentoclose_list_agents, opentoclose_list_contacts, opentoclose_list_property_contacts, opentoclose_create_contact, opentoclose_add_property_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
